interpretation_notes: q_surface/q_interior and J surface/interior are disjoint location classes for the q-bad or J-bad count respectively; face-only interior can still touch constrained boundary vertices.
near-feature q/J counts are cell classifications; unknown feature counts remain separate.
short edge shares use bad_union (a unique q-or-J-bad cell set) as denominator.
geometry_excess_hist is a disjoint excess-bin histogram; geometry_authority_types overlap and need not sum to geometry_bad.
fixed drift tracks 16 unique global points replicated on six ranks (96 readings), not 96 distinct points; owned_sum is the distributed ownership total.
commits in quality stage rows are window increments; commits_total is cumulative. q/J ladder/event counts are event churn, not census counts.
busy, join-call and tracked-collective timers are overlapping scopes, not additive elapsed time.
